articles.title: Polymarket says No for May, Yes for June after Strategy's recent bitcoin sale
articles.snippet: UMA voters ruled that Strategy's June 1 disclosure counted for the June contract, even though the company said it sold bitcoin during the final week of May.

articles.title: Coinbase launches pre-IPO markets, starting with Elon Musk’s SpaceX
articles.snippet: Coinbase launches pre-IPO markets starting with SpaceX, offering non-US users perpetual futures tied to private company valuations amid rising competition.

articles.title: Wyoming executive order to guide AI data center development

articles.title: Revolut US bank plans stablecoins alongside FDIC-insured accounts: Report
articles.snippet: Reuters reported that Revolut plans to integrate stablecoins into its future US bank as more fintech and crypto companies chase federal banking approvals.
